title: The Lovasz-Softmax Loss: A Tractable Surrogate for the Optimization of the Intersection-Over-Union Measure in Neural Networks
mechanism: Convex surrogate of the Jaccard loss via the Lovasz extension of sorted errors.
adaptation: Lovasz hinge on crack and Lovasz-softmax over present classes, computed over the whole batch (not per image) to match pooled IoU; hard labels only (cannot take soft targets). smp, the house library, ships an implementation.
min_experiment: Arm CE + Lovasz (crack + inactive) vs SUP100, 5 v 5. Kill if crack IoU < +0.012.
evidence: R: widely used IoU surrogate (1239 cites); JML paper App. E finds it equal to JML with hard labels (Cityscapes 75.53 vs 75.55).

alt_notes.adaptation: Lovasz hinge on crack and Lovasz-softmax over present classes, per batch (per_image False) to match pooled IoU; smp LossLovasz already in the house library; hard labels only.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: CE + Lovasz (crack, per batch), 5 seeds; baseline SUP100. Kill: crack IoU < +0.012.
